videos.overview: The class has started playing a new game on mobile called Rockamuffin. Bertram scores lightning-fast top points in the game to the great frustration of the others, who cannot keep up. And not only that, Bertram is also a wildly bad winner.

videos.title: The new couple
videos.overview: Martine and Mads have decided to become lovers as they think the class' popular boy and girl will be the perfect couple. Just not everyone thinks it's a good idea. In fact, Esther is deeply envious as she herself is in love with Mads.

videos.title: Beaten in the schoolyard
videos.overview: Tobias is witnessing the big boys from school beating a little boy. And since there is no adult to intervene, he decides to take action himself. Someone has to defend the little boy! But he should never have done that.

videos.title: Pigs on Insta
videos.overview: Sif is bored as she is not allowed to come with Josefine and Mathilde to the braces dentist. Therefore, she spends her time on Instagram, leaving a comment below one of Josefine's photos. A comment that certainly does not fall into good soil with either Josefine or Mathilde.

videos.title: Stay away!
videos.overview: Bertram has been busy with his Youtube channel and has therefore not been able to nurture his friendships. Therefore, he suddenly feels alone. When he tries to join the other boys' Barca club, he is rejected.

videos.title: Bad hair day
videos.overview: Sif gets teased with her red hair. The big boys think it's fun to call her both Pippi and Strawberry Helmet. She is well and truly tired of it, and therefore she decides to do something about the problem.

videos.title: The secret blog
videos.overview: The class participates in a competition where they have to write a blog. The best blog will be released, and that means the world to Aida, who will do anything to win the competition. The problem is just that she has no idea what to write about.

videos.title: Who does Tobias write with? Part 1
videos.overview: Tobias has met a skilled gamer Jeppe in WoW. Jeppe believes that Tobias is good enough to join a guild for young talents, where he can be paid to play. But Jeppe may not be quite who he pretends to be, and suddenly Tobias is uncomfortable.

videos.title: Who does Tobias write with? Part 2
videos.overview: Tobias is blackmailed by Jeppe as he has written online. For it turns out that Jeppe is not a boy, but a man who wants Tobias to send pictures of himself without clothes on. Tobias is afraid to say it to anyone.

videos.title: More confidence
videos.overview: Tobias thinks Signe is pretty cool because she never cares what others think of her. Therefore, he would like to choose her, as the class needs new sidekicks. But Tobias can not help but worry about what Bertram will say if he finds out.

videos.title: Martine's Wedding - Part 1
videos.overview: Martine is pressured by the Black Squad to hold a real school wedding with cake, decorations and everything else that belongs. Actually, the idea sounds funny, but the squad wants Martine to marry the ugliest and palest boy in class.

videos.title: Martine's Wedding - Part 2
videos.overview: Martine is threatened with being thrown out of the Black Squad if she does not marry Tobias for the school wedding. But Tobias can feel that something is wrong and does not want to marry her. That's why Martine gets desperate.

videos.title: Bullied on Youtube
videos.overview: Bertram and Signe will be getting new guests for their talk show on YouTube. Sif and the twins report, and must each comment on the topic of the day, which is bullying. But once they start, the talk show escalates completely.

videos.title: A place in the record book
videos.overview: The class has an activity day at school, where they must try to break records from the Children's Record Book. Aida and Josefine have set out to work together to break the ultimate record. But it is not quite easy when you can not figure out how to cooperate.

videos.title: Are you adopted?
videos.overview: Rumors have spread in the class that Clara has been adopted. And when Clara finds out that Martine may be one of those who has set the rumor in motion, she threatens to reveal Martine's secret to the rest of the class.

videos.title: Licking on toilet seat
videos.overview: Caroline is bored and joins Tobias, Bertram and Mikkel's jackass group "SLIK-LOL". Here they challenge each other to lick on things. To start with, it's really fun, but suddenly Caroline has to do a really nasty challenge.

videos.title: Thrown out of the group
videos.overview: Mikkel, Bertram and Tobias have a gamer club after school. Mikkel is very happy with the group because he is the best and because he can continue to have the gamer club, even though he will soon have to change schools. But suddenly Mikkel discovers that Bertram and Tobias have other plans.

videos.title: New Girl in the Squad - Part 1
videos.overview: Esther has had her period and is seeking help from the big girls. It makes her twin sister Agnes feel overlooked, and therefore she seeks company with the Black Squad. But the squad has sinister plans.

videos.title: New girl in the squad - part 2
videos.overview: Esther is mad at her twin sister Agnes after their turbulence with the Black Squad. In fact, so angry that she will never talk to Agnes again.

videos.title: Bertram's music video
videos.overview: Bertram has been thrown out the door and decides to spend the wait making a music video with Sif. By accident, they get to film the school's big boys standing and painting graffiti. They should never have done that!

videos.title: In love with the chat
videos.overview: Tobias is happy to read a blog called The Girl and the Cat. And then he's actually also starting to fall a little in love with the girl behind the blog. The problem is just that he does not know who she is.

videos.title: Is he crazy about me?
videos.overview: Josefine loves Frederik, but she can't find out if he loves her too. Therefore, she asks Mathilde for advice to get wiser. But Mathilde is more keen to get Josefine set up with one of the older boys.

videos.title: Queen of the Class
videos.overview: A new queen of the class must be chosen, but Caroline and Signe have received an equal number of votes. Therefore, the class has the rest of the day to vote on which of the two has earned the crown. The girls agree not to influence people to vote for them.

videos.title: Known from TV
videos.overview: When a TV team comes to the school to make a news feature, Bertram immediately eyes the opportunity to become famous. That is why he does everything to be chosen for the TV feature, and of course he succeeds. But his stubbornness backfires.

videos.title: Frederik and Josefine - part 1
videos.overview: Martine is tired of seeing Josefine and Frederik go crazy with each other without doing anything about it. Therefore, she decides to bring the two turtle doves together once and for all. But both Josefine and Frederik are skeptical of her.

videos.title: Frederik and Josefine - part 2
videos.overview: Josefine and Frederik are still locked inside the school after Martine's plan to bring them together has gone a bit wrong. But has she managed to bring them together anyway? Or have they become unfriendly after spending an entire night together at school?

videos.title: What is Magnus hiding? part 1
videos.overview: It's Magnus first day at a new school. He is very keen on making a good first impression and figure out who is the popular kids. Christian gives him an introduction to everyone. When Ida interferes, Christians sense Magnus has a secret.

videos.title: Charging BFF
videos.overview: After joining the handball team Lea and Gry has become close friends. Lea wants to spend all her time with Gry, however Gry also wants to spend time with her other friends.

videos.title: Snitch!
videos.overview: Ida and Magnus' relation as step siblings comes to the test when Alma bumps into Ida and drops her phone. Will Magnus tell the truth or stick with Alma's story?

videos.title: In love in four minutes
videos.overview: Christian feels sad. He doesn't know how to tell Smilla how he feels. He seeks comfort with Stine, who has read an article on how to catch your crush. Christian is not quite convinced, so they test the 4 minute rule on each other.

videos.title: Far from a diva
videos.overview: Nomi envy the popular girls squad, so she decides to make her own with Ronja. When the boys find the pictures they've taken funny, Nomi hopes that she can be part of their "loser squad", but is a squad more important than best friends?

videos.title: A serious news
videos.overview: When the class is told that Lea's parents are getting divorced. Viola tell the class to avoid all topics related to parents and family. Hugo arrives late so haven't heard the plan. Is avoidance really what Lea want?

videos.title: No longer foster siblings, part 1
videos.overview: Magnus has been in a bad mood lately. Ida thinks it's because of their parents divorce, which she has promised not to tell the class. When he snaps at his best friend, she decides to tell the class, but is it the divorce that makes him sad?

videos.title: No longer foster siblings, part 2
videos.overview: Magnus has been in a bad mood lately. Ida thinks it's because of their parents divorce, which she has promised not to tell the class. When he snaps at his best friend, she decides to tell the class, but is it the divorce that makes him sad?

videos.title: Stealing from the teacher's room
videos.overview: It's Magnus last day, and Ida has planned a surprise for him. Magnus is conflicted, he doesn't want to hurt his mother and doesn't want to leave his classmates, but how can he tell his parents that?

videos.title: No invitation
videos.overview: Ellie plan a party. She is allowed to invite 10 people, matching the number of girls in class. When she invites two of the boys, leaving Nomi out, Lea is torn. Should she go to the party and hook up with Alfred or go dancing with Nomi?

videos.title: The mystery of the broken skull
videos.overview: A skull has been damaged, so the teachers starts an interrogation of the suspects last seen in the class room.

videos.title: All for Alma
videos.overview: Storm has a crush on Alma from 8th grade, so when she asks him for a favor, he cancels his CS GO gaming night with Otto. Otto has his suspicions as to Alma's real intentions.

videos.title: Phobia for snot
videos.overview: Kasper is anxious for the upcoming test in chemistry. When the teacher place him in a group with Inge he has to overcome his phobia for mucus.

videos.title: Stupid for you
videos.overview: Ronja has a crush on Magnus. In order to be able to spend time with Magnus she has made a plan for how to get in a group with him.

videos.title: A tacky challenge
videos.overview: Pelle has challenged Ida to sing whenever she talks, so when she's called up to the blackboard to solve an equation she has to think fast, in order not to become the laughing stock.

videos.title: Never in love
videos.overview: The class get the assignment to compose lyrics for a song. Pelle get the theme love, but how do you write about love when you've never been in love with anyone?

videos.title: Christian's crush, part 1
videos.overview: Christian has a small crush on Nanna. Just when he has worked up the courage to ask her out, she asks him to set her up with Konrad from one of the older classes. Christian is not sure it's a good idea but helps Nanna any way.

videos.title: Christian's crush, part 2
videos.overview: After receiving the text from Konrad, Nanna is the 7th heaven. When he invites her to the skate park, she immediately accepts, there's just one challenge - she doesn't know how to skate. Christian reluctantly agrees to help her.

videos.title: My worst, best friend
videos.overview: Laurits lost a bet to Kasper so he has to be Kasper's servant for the week. When Nisha has to be the class' head girl alone, Kasper offers his assistance to get her attention, however his plan backfires.

videos.title: Rich kid?
videos.overview: When Ronja overhears Alfred saying that Magnus are into rich girls, she asks Mika and Viola for help. Is Magnus really into rich girls and will it help Ronja become closer to him that she appears to be rich?

videos.title: Crisis in the classroom, part 1
videos.overview: There's a lot of noise and disturbance in the classroom, and nobody is really getting along. Viola has a plan - she wants to have a birthday party in class, and asks Ronja for help.

videos.title: Crisis in the classroom, part 2
videos.overview: Ronja doesn't understand what she has done that has made Viola so mad. Kasper gives her a hint as to what it could be and she tries to make up for her mistake.

videos.title: A wet accident
videos.overview: Pelle and Viola are working on a project and Ida feel left out. In order to get Pelle's attention, Ida invokes their challenge game, forcing Pelle to pretend he has an invisible friend.

videos.title: Albertes wannabes
videos.overview: Alberte has to choose between French and German, and decides to ask her friends for advice, however her friends just wants the same as her.

videos.title: The secret SMS
videos.overview: Vicky has been in a really bad mood lately and the class wonder why. Viola by chance see a text on Vicky's phone, and together with Storm tries to solve the issue Vicky has with her boyfriend.

videos.title: The Missing Girlfriend Letter, Part 1
videos.overview: Ida has a crush on Laurits. She doesn't know how to tell him. The option to tell him via text is gone when their phones are collected. She tries to tell him in person, which doesn't go well. Her final option is the love letter.

videos.title: The Missing Girlfriend Letter, Part 2
videos.overview: Ida don't want to take any chances when being black mailed, so she brings the one kilo candy the blackmailer has asked for. Laurits attempt to help Ida backfires, and she receives a new demand.

videos.title: The Missing Girlfriend Letter, Part 3
videos.overview: Laurits and Ida spot that Alberte, Kasper and Viola still have their phones. They send a message to the Instagram profile in hope that they can reveal who is behind, but none of the 3 pick up their phones.

videos.title: The Missing Girlfriend Letter, Part 4
videos.overview: With the thief's demand for more candy Ida is about to give up. Laurits get the idea to use the drone to keep an eye on the candy. When the drone crash Ida gets expelled from school making her regret writing the letter.

videos.title: The Missing Girlfriend Letter, Part 5
videos.overview: Time is about to run out when Laurits gets the idea to use the footage from the drone demonstration to reveal who has stolen the letter.

videos.title: Kick me!
videos.overview: Viola has worked hard with learning to program their micro bit. Kasper is impressed with her work and convince her to hand over the code. When Kasper misuse her code to make fun of people, she gets really mad.

videos.title: Love or football
videos.overview: Sigurd has a small crush on Mika and usually they bike to school together, but lately it seems to Sigurd that Mika is trying to avoid him. He's afraid of what will happen if he tells her how he feels.

videos.title: How to kiss?
videos.overview: Ida would really like to be part of a girls night. When she hear the popular girls discuss kissing, she lies and tell them that she knows how to kiss. When her best friends can't help her with information she search the Internet.

videos.title: Magnus bully
videos.overview: Ida is annoyed that Magnus and Christian keep pulling pranks on their substitute teachers, so she and Pelle decides to ask their new substitute for help pulling a prank on them.

videos.title: Fortnite Fail
videos.overview: Alfred is in charge of getting t-shirts for the Fortnite team. When his dad deliver the shirts, he realize he has made a mistake and only ordered size small. How will he tell Ask that the shirt is to small for him?

videos.title: The girls' locker room
videos.overview: When Kasper and Laurits play with Laurits new robot during gym class they are sent to the changing rooms. Kasper improve the mBot by adding his phone as a camera, which cause trouble when the mBot ends up in the girls changing room.

videos.title: The perfect profile, del 1
videos.overview: Storm has a crush on Alberte. In order to get to know her better he creates a fake profile on Instagram and starts writing sweet comments on her pictures. His plan backfires when Alberte gets interested in the fake person.

videos.title: The perfect profile, del 2
videos.overview: Kasper does his best to help Storm come up with an excuse for the failed date with Alberte and she agrees to give the date another chance.

videos.title: A cracked double date
videos.overview: Laurits and Ida want to spend more time together but their friends keep bugging them. Laurits gets the idea to try to make Kasper and Pelle to become friends, so that they all four can be together.

videos.title: Do not press the button
videos.overview: Mika, Christian and Magnus are bored during recess. Christian and Magnus have heard a rumor about a secret button located in the basement. Mika claims she is brave enough to push the button to see what happens.

videos.title: Copy girls
videos.overview: It's time for the class photo and Viola has found the perfect hairstyle for the day. Alberte shows up with the same hairstyle and everyone believes that it's Viola that has copied Alberte's idea.

videos.title: The fake autograph
videos.overview: Magnus tries to sell his signed Manchester shirt to Otto. Ronja spots that the autograph is fake and confronts Magnus. He admits that his story is made up. He can only come to the movies by selling it, so Ronja promise to keep the secret.

videos.title: Afraid to fail
videos.overview: When Alfred tease Pelle about being afraid of the dark, Pelle accepts Alfreds challenge to go to the basement and see who can stay the longest. Pelle pleads Ida to help him beat Alfred.

videos.title: Murder in the basement
videos.overview: The class have a sleepover at the school. Magnus, Alfred and Alberte have a plan to try to break each of the 3 rules set by the teachers.

videos.title: A night at school
videos.overview: Inge is afraid that her classmates will laugh at her if she can't answer the teachers questions, so she is hesitant to raise her hand. When she sees how little Hugo cares about the class laughing at him, she decides to ask him for help.

videos.title: Fortnite squad
videos.overview: The Fortnite squad is in need of a fourth player. They decide that whoever reach level 70 first will get the spot. When Noah can't keep up with Alfred's progress, he decides to cheat.

videos.title: Laurits is a psychic
videos.overview: Laurits thinks he's become psychic because things he thinks begins to happen. He tries to talk to his best friend Kasper, but he just makes fun of him.

videos.title: The world's worst birthday
videos.overview: It's Albertes birthday and everything is perfect. Then Ellie post an ugly photo of her on Instagram.

videos.title: Mother on dating, part 1
videos.overview: Laurits mom has used his phone so when Kasper wan't to show Laurits something, her dating profile pops up on the screen. Kasper promise not to tell anyone, a promise he keeps until Laurits tell their classmates about baby pictures of him.

videos.title: Mother on dating, part 2
videos.overview: Laurits is mad at Kasper after he showed the class her moms dating profile. The class keeps making fun of it which wasn't Kasper's intention, so he tries his best to make up for what he have done. Meanwhile Nisha tries to comfort Laurits.

videos.title: Alberta is a drama queen
videos.overview: Alberte and Magnus have a big quarrel in the schoolyard, and everyone wonders what it is about. Alberte accuse Magnus of lying to her. He doesn't understand what the fuss is all about.

videos.title: Flirt out of control
videos.overview: When Laurits mom and teacher starts flirting he find a way to benefit from it. All is going well until his teacher becomes an embarrassment in front of the classmates.

videos.title: Weapons in school
videos.overview: In the library Viola and Nanna hear an older boy talking about weapons. They find that he's been searching for weapons on the net and decide to alert their teacher. When he doesn't listen, they take the matter into their own hands.

videos.title: Crybaby
videos.overview: The class is playing indoor football when Mika in the heat of the game call Luna a whiner, causing Luna to get mad and wanting revenge.

videos.title: Maybe boyfriends?
videos.overview: Ida and Laurits has become very close, but haven't put words on it yet, so when Kasper asks them if they are a couple, they give different answers.

videos.title: Never again diva, part 1
videos.overview: Alberte has started sharing personal details on her YouTube channel. Her friends are worried about her sharing so many details. When Alberte talk about a stalker following her, everyone is eager to help her.

videos.title: Never again diva, part 2
videos.overview: Albertes story about her stalker has made her YouTube channel grow, and she is getting new sponsors. What will happen when the class figure out that the story is made up?

videos.title: The world's most embarrassing mother
videos.overview: Laurits and Ida has started dating and she's supposed to come to his house after school. Laurits is afraid that his mom will be an embarrassment, and her FaceTime call in class doesn't make it better.

videos.title: The secret party
videos.overview: Nanna, Luna and Ellie is planning something but won't tell Alberte what it is. Ronja tries to help, but her help back-fires.

videos.title: The new queen of divas
videos.overview: It's time for the class' first German lesson. All the girls think that German is stupid, so Luna fear that she won't be able to replace Alberte as queen of the class, if they learn that she actually speaks German.

videos.title: Flirt in the air
videos.overview: Everyone is still avoiding Alberte because of her fake story about Pelle. When the class has to do a group assignment, Magnus is forced to work with her. But is she as bad as everyone makes her.

videos.title: Fools in traffic
videos.overview: Kasper has joined the school crossing guards with the aim to go on the trip to Tivoli. When a little girl is about to be hit by a car, Laurits tries to kill the story with a bribe.

videos.title: Ida smashes the streak
videos.overview: Ida and Nomi are about to reach their 200th streak on Snapchat, when Nomi has to go on a family trip without her phone and they agree that Ida should take care of Nomi's streaks while she is gone.

videos.title: Obsessed with branded goods
videos.overview: Alfred is obsessed with wearing the right brands. When he comes to school wearing a new cap, and none of his friends notice, he decides to find some new friends to hang out with.

videos.title: Luna likehunter
videos.overview: Alberte is still being excluded by the other kids after her fake story about Pelle. When Luna challenge her to a Instagram like competition, she accepts, hoping that it will make her popular again.

videos.title: Filmed in secret
videos.overview: Alfred has filmed Storm singing in the shower after gym. Storm beg Alfred to delete the video, but soon the entire class has seen it. Alberte offers to help Storm.

videos.title: Hate Harry Potter
videos.overview: When the Danish YouTuber Anders Hemmingsen posts a look-a-like competition, Kasper, Hugo and Magnus starts discussing what to dress up as. When Hugo and Kasper is not serious enough, Magnus decides to skip their ideas.

videos.title: Cheated by friend
videos.overview: Noah is having trouble with math and gets help from Thea, in return Noah promise to choose her when they play football. When Noah doesn't keep his promise, Thea will no longer help him.

videos.title: Obsessed with breasts
videos.overview: The class is taught about the female body and Kasper and Laurits are eager to learn everything about breasts. Their eagerness to test a bra with various fruits, and their comments about the size, end up hurting Viola.

videos.title: Magic wand or pee man
videos.overview: Pelle is really into magic tricks and has made his own magic wand. When Alfred and Noah starts poking fun about him and his magic wand, he doesn't get why. When Ida explains why, he almost give up on his new show.

videos.title: Girl secrets
videos.overview: It's time for the class' sex ed, and the girls have their own private lesson, in which they receive a bag. The boys are very interested in getting to know what's in the bag. When the girls won't tell them, they make a plan.

videos.title: The naughty time capsule
videos.overview: When the class is assigned the task to create a time capsule, Kasper is keen on making the perfect one, since his older brother, has told him stories of all the cool things they put in theirs.

videos.title: Pain in the breasts
videos.overview: The kids are playing football when Ida is hit in the chest. Hugo is concerned as it appears that it hurt real bad. When Ida doesn't want to talk about it, he gets more concerned and he starts searching for possible causes on the Internet.

videos.title: Is Luna lying? part 1
videos.overview: Luna has arranged a movie night and invited the boys. Nanna and Ellie is a bit concerned because Luna tend to be a drama queen, especially with boys around.

videos.title: Is Luna lying? part 2
videos.overview: With all of Luna's lies, Nanna and Ellie struggle to believe that her cat is really dead. They decide to give her one last chance.

videos.title: The worst sidekick
videos.overview: The class are having new seats, and Ida is very eager to sit next to Laurits. Laurits is concerned that Ida will be a disturbance, so he tells the teacher that Ida is copying his work, to get her moved to the front of the class.

videos.title: Creepy chain message
videos.overview: When Storm receives a chain message bad things starts happening to him, so he forwards the message to 10 of his friends.

videos.title: Popular with the boys
videos.overview: Stine is always hanging out with the boys. She doesn't feel she get the same attention from them as the popular girls, so she decides to try to be more like a girl.

videos.title: Ball or breakdance
videos.overview: When Alfred has to cancel the football match, he is afraid to tell Mika the true reason why. Mika thinks that Alfred has canceled just to support Ellie for her musical audition, so she makes the entire team turn on him.

videos.title: Who has lice?
videos.overview: Ellie is just returning from the nurse, when it's announced that there is lice at school, so everyone think that it is her that is the source, not even Alfred will believe that it is not her.

videos.title: Viola goes crazy
videos.overview: Viola's mom don't want her to hang out with her friends after school, which cause her to no longer be invited. When she's the only one in class who has made their homework, she finally has enough.

videos.title: Giant clown
videos.overview: Kasper is annoyed that Laurits is always busy texting with Ida, so together with Gry he steals his phone. While sending screen caps from Laurits phone Kasper figures out that having something in common makes it easier to talk to Gry.

videos.title: Too picky about love
videos.overview: Ida is very finicky when it comes to food, especially fruits, so when Laurits has brought a cake she's really happy - until it turns out it's a banana cake. Pelle offers to help Ida learn to eat bananas so she won't hurt Laurits.

videos.title: Livestream goes wrong
videos.overview: Laurits is streaming live from his lunchbox, but struggle to get more viewers. When Kasper disturbs the stream, in order to get Laurits to go play basketball with him, the view count explodes.

videos.title: Bloody Mary
videos.overview: When Magnus act all tough and not scared of anything in front of the girls, Kasper decides to try to scare him. He makes Laurits dress up as "Bloody Mary", but they really struggle to get Magnus attention.

videos.title: Bullied on livestream
videos.overview: When Ellie makes a spelling mistake in a comment on Alfred's live stream, a kid from another class starts making fun of her. Alfred's attempt to help her, just makes the matter worse.

videos.title: Ditched
videos.overview: Inge is always well prepared for class, in contrast to Hugo, who always forget his things. She's tired of always having to supply him. When she finally has enough, and don't want to share, the others starts to call her cheap.

videos.title: The lure to peck
videos.overview: Ellie has a small crush on Alfred, so when he suggest that they skip classes together she agrees.

videos.title: The Hacker Mystery, Part 1
videos.overview: Christian is not doing well in school. When his brother tells him that he needs to improve, or he will get kicked out, he doesn't believe him. That changes when his German teacher pulls him aside after class.

videos.title: The Hacker Mystery, Part 2
videos.overview: Christian claims that it is not him who have hacked the schools intranet, but IT-Allan demand that he proves his innocence. Magnus appear to have quite some knowledge of what is going on.

videos.title: The Hacker Mystery, Part 3
videos.overview: When the subject for the theme week is changed to UFO's, Christian is convinced that Storm is behind the hacking.

videos.title: The Hacker Mystery, Part 4
videos.overview: When Christian confronts his brother Max with being the hacker, telling him to turn himself in, Max threatens to take Christian and his friends with him in the fall.

videos.title: The Hacker Mystery, Part 5
videos.overview: With Nanna being accused for hacking the intranet, Christian is desperate to get it all sorted out. A talk with his German teacher gives him an idea for a solution.

videos.title: Bloodshed
videos.overview: Ellie and Lea each want to prove that they are Luna's BFF. Their competitiveness prevents them from actually being there for Luna when she needs them the most.

videos.title: Fake for likes
videos.overview: In order to get more likes, Luna is posting photos of Storm's drawings under her own Instagram account, without giving Storm credit for his work.

videos.title: The clown of the class
videos.overview: Kasper is annoyed that everyone believes that he can only be funny and never serious, so when the class has to do a presentation, he decides to try to change that.

videos.title: Stinker-Storm
videos.overview: Storm farts during the class' morning yoga, which cause a bit of teasing from his classmates. Soon it's not only the classmates, but also the older students that starts teasing him. Alfred tries to stand up for Storm.

videos.title: Ronja's dream job
videos.overview: Ronja dreams of becoming a journalist and is working on an application for an internship. When Pelle, who doesn't know what he wants to be, is better at asking questions, Ronja starts doubting herself.

videos.title: Storms stink-girlfriend
videos.overview: Storm is still being bullied by the older kids. When Ronja tries to stand up for him, Dennis threaten to post the photos he has taken of her and Storm sitting together.

videos.title: Embarrassing baby pictures
videos.overview: Magnus notice how popular the head of the student council is with the girls, so he decides to run himself. The election campaign is going well, when suddenly baby pictures of Magnus starts showing up.

videos.title: Revenge of bullying
videos.overview: The bullying of Storm has gone out of hand, so the class decides to stand up for Storm, and do something about it, but they don't want to do it the way their teacher suggests.

videos.title: Win a school party

videos.overview: Mathilde pushes Caro and Gertrud into an Insta-challenge where they have to prove that they love themselves. The question is, is Mathilde pushing too hard or are there other ways to prove that you love yourself?

videos.title: Episode 1000: Class Reunion
videos.overview: The school's 100th anniversary is to be celebrated, and at the head of it are teachers Michael, Caroline and Mathilde. However, unexpected guests arrive and the party takes a new turn.

videos.title: An enemy from the past, part 2
videos.overview: Mathilde is about to lose her best friends, but when she realizes her own mistakes, there is hope that everything can be made right.

videos.title: Do Tue and Sif have something going on?
videos.overview: Cornelius is in a group with Sif and Tue, but is frustrated that the atmosphere is so tense. It turns out that something happened earlier in the day that they need to clarify in order to move forward.

videos.title: Don't want to be a snitch

videos.overview: December is approaching and Emma is excited because she loves Christmas. But this year, Kat has decided to change the class advent calendar tradition for a good cause, causing Emma to create drama. Why is Emma really upset about changing the Christmas tradition?

videos.title: My new class? (Part 1)
videos.overview: It's time for the class to wish for who they want to be in class with next year. Alliances begin to form, so what will it all come down to?

videos.title: My new class? (Part 2)
videos.overview: Mathilde is furious with Caroline after discovering she's not on Caroline's wish list for the new classes. Their enmity extends to Gertrude, and it's now even more exciting to find out who's going to class with whom.

videos.title: My new class? (Part 3)
videos.overview: The new classes are announced and everyone is happy - except Cornelius, who is suddenly without his girlfriend, Caroline. Can their relationship survive being torn apart, or will Cornelius have to use cunning methods to change the division?

videos.title: Just dance, Musa!
videos.overview: Musa is fascinated by Esme, who is a great dancer, and wants to be as good as her. But Erik warns him that dancing with a girl is the same as going on a date with her. Or is it?

videos.title: The anthem of support
videos.overview: Luna feels sad when she sees videos about children in need on TikTok. She realizes she has to do something to help, and together with Baldur and Mads she comes up with the idea to create a support song. But maybe Sif has a much better plan?

videos.title: A new friend?
videos.overview: Johannes is still down about Tue making other friends in class and seeks solace in the cave they made together. But it turns out he's not the only one seeking shelter there. Maybe the cave offers a whole new friendship?

videos.title: A dramatic reading lesson
videos.overview: It's reading class and Sif and Cornelius are tired of being in a group with Mads and Zoe, who constantly interrupt them because they're bored. But maybe reading class isn't so bad if you get to create the story yourself?

videos.title: Caves & Dragons (Part 3)
videos.overview: Sif and the rest of the gang have decided to stop playing G&D because they are tired of their classmates' comments. The message angers Club Ras, who kills their characters. The group is now officially finished with the game, but maybe they will in the future.

videos.title: Caves & Dragons (Part 4)
videos.overview: Tue has decided to ask Sif if they should hang out together one day after school. He doesn't have the courage to do it himself, but thinks his character, Leopold, can help him?

videos.title: The class stink!
videos.overview: Zoe is now the only one who showers after PE and she's getting sick of it because the class stinks! What can she do to change the others' minds? And what does a smoked mackerel have to do with her plan?

videos.title: Awkward sex education
videos.overview: Kian will do anything to avoid sex education with Gry because he finds it too awkward. Luckily, the technique fails and Kian sees it as an opportunity to escape. But he doesn't let go that easily.

videos.title: Help - I'm going on a date!
videos.overview: After the last game of Caves and Dragons, Sif agreed to go on a date with Tue, and now the day has come. But Tue is super nervous, because how do you even go on a date? And has he really misunderstood Sif's answer?

videos.title: Who is dating my sister?
videos.overview: When Johannes finds out that someone is trying to pick up his stepsister, Sif, he asks Tue for help. But why is Tue afraid to admit that it's really all about him?

videos.title: Superfan of Ida (part 1)
videos.overview: Sofie is a huge fan of singer Ida, so when she discovers that Ida is offering a visit to the class that sends in the best video, she goes all in to win the competition. But what does the rest of the class think of Sofie's plan to win the competition all by herself?

videos.title: Superfan of Ida (part 2)
videos.overview: Thanks to Musa, the class has won a visit with superstar Ida. Sofie is her biggest fan and freaks out when Ida asks her for help. But maybe it's actually Ida who can help Sofie.

videos.title: Skincare fail
videos.overview: Emma looks up to Kat's older sister, who makes beauty videos on TikTok, and will do anything to look like her. So when she gets the chance to try her skincare products, she's thrilled. But Emma is going to regret it.

videos.title: Is ChatGPT cheating?
videos.overview: Thas and Sofie don't understand why everyone is asking Olly for advice when they need to find new book recommendations at the library. It turns out that Olly is using ChatGPT, but isn't that illegal?

videos.title: Flirt or cousin?
videos.overview: Valdemar is Gertrud's cousin, but when Caro and Mathilde think they're dating, she lies and says yes because she feels more comfortable now that she has a boyfriend. But how does Gertrud get out of this lie?

videos.title: Drama for baking competition
videos.overview: When Patrick gets bored in food class, he tries to create drama between students. However, it quickly backfires when he is found out and ends up paying the price for spreading false rumors.

videos.title: Is Caro breaking up with you?
videos.overview: Caro has decided to break up with Cornelius, but wants to do it in a way that won't upset him. Is there even a good way to break up?

videos.title: S.I.S.T.E.R.S.
videos.overview: The school's patrol is the toughest in town and goes by the name S.I.S.T.E.R.S. They are put to a real test when they have to rescue a ball from the school neighbor, the evil Miss Von Heckelschmerz's garden.

videos.title: Sensitive guy
videos.overview: Cornelius is down after his breakup with Caroline, but doesn't dare show it to the other boys. He's afraid of being teased for being sensitive. But maybe he's not the only one?

videos.title: Standing up all day
videos.overview: Niels has found that standing up is much healthier than sitting down and doing work. Zoe, Musa and Jennifer see it as an opportunity to challenge him to stand all day.

videos.title: The school's creepy neighbor (part 1)
videos.overview: The school's neighbor, Miss Von Heckelschmerz, is furious when Niels, Musa, Zoe and Nadia play loud music at school. But what does a stolen dog and a secret past have to do with it all?

videos.title: The school's creepy neighbor (part 2)
videos.overview: Niels, Musa, Zoe and Nadia are still in trouble with Miss Von Heckelschmerz. But it turns out that Zoe might be a lot closer to her neighbor than she thought. Maybe the neighbor drama is coming to an end?

videos.title: Kian tastes his own medicine
videos.overview: Kian pressures Olly to set the class clock forward so they can have recess early. Unfortunately, Olly is busted by Patrick and Kian leaves him to take the blame. But is there really another prank in the works?

videos.title: Why is Sofie lying?
videos.overview: Sofie loves committees and gets angry when she's not allowed to join Baldur, Nadia and Esme's culture committee. Sofie pretends to be Swedish so she can join, but ends up letting her best friend down due to her massive FOMO.

videos.title: The big threats (part 1)
videos.overview: Someone has peed in Niels' bag and the accusation quickly falls on Hassan and Olivia, two creepy 9th graders. But what does Cornelius have to do with it all?

videos.title: Camp trip (Part 2)
videos.overview: The rumor that Sif and Tue are dating has spread and Sif gets angry with Tue for telling. But why do they have to be secret lovers?

videos.overview: Jennifer worries about her mom, who seems lonely after her parents' divorce. So she skips a great concert and lies to Esme. But maybe Jennifer's concern is misguided?

videos.overview: The class is talking about confirmation and Baldur is in turmoil. Does he even want to be confirmed? And how do you know what you believe in?

videos.overview: Esme is not allowed on social media and looks over Jennifer's shoulder as she has no screen rules. But when they see something creepy on TikTok, the girls have second thoughts. Maybe screen rules aren't so stupid after all?

videos.title: Rat snack challenge

videos.title: What have I done?
videos.overview: When Kian arrives at school, he feels like Olly is giving him the cold shoulder. But why is Olly so angry? What has Kian done?

videos.title: Poor excuse
videos.overview: Nadia is feeling stressed and looking forward to a quiet evening with her family. However, she realizes that she forgot an appointment with Zoe and Gertrud and lies about why she can't make it.

videos.title: Dreams for the future
videos.overview: The class is making dream booklets in art class and Thas and Luna approach the task very differently. Is there a right and a wrong way to dream about your future?

videos.title: An ugly dress rehearsal

videos.title: A terrible start to school
videos.overview: Luna has nightmares about the first day of school in her new class where everyone hates her. But why is Luna so nervous?

videos.title: The big premiere
videos.overview: The class gets nervous before the show starts when they realize that the new students are in the audience. Suddenly it becomes important that everything is perfect, but maybe the last day together should be about something completely different?

videos.title: Welcome home, Coco!

videos.title: Club Summer Lies
videos.overview: Liva is ashamed of not having traveled or done anything exciting and exotic during the summer holidays. So why does the new class teacher, Christoffer, keep asking annoying questions about her summer vacation? Will Liva get away with lying and pretending she's been to Paris - or will someone discover the lie?

videos.title: Mission: Longer breaks!
videos.overview: Daniel dreams of being captain of the school soccer team, but recess isn't long enough for him to practice a lot and get really good. Together with Ruben and Frede, he devises a cunning plan that requires them to get rid of Turid - but it won't work.

videos.title: The girls from Planet Pluto
videos.overview: Mimi has decided to save the planet by changing her habits! She will no longer buy new clothes, but instead only shop second-hand. But what does she do with her new principles when Cleo and Bjørk from grade 9 launch the coolest new clothing brand?

videos.title: Are we even compatible?
videos.overview: August has second thoughts about his relationship with Sofia when he realizes that she loves doing TikTok dances to superficial pop music. Can they even be a couple if they don't even like the same music?

videos.title: Funniest in class?
videos.overview: Vester and Jakob want to prove they are the funniest in the class and make a bet with Asger: they have to make Turid laugh. But what makes the world's angriest teacher laugh?

videos.title: Drama over Class Insta
videos.overview: Daniel wants to host the class's shared Insta profile and has a lot of plans to go viral with his awesome videos. But what does he do when the class suddenly appoints Ruben as host?

videos.title: Stains
videos.overview: Daniel throws his friends Ruben and Frede under the bus, and in return they sabotage Daniel's presentation. But he won't let them get away with it and takes a cruel revenge. Will Daniel go too far?

videos.overview: Sofia and Coco are struggling to reconnect after Coco has been out of class for a year. At the same time, Sofia feels rejected by August, who suddenly seems more interested in Coco. Can Sofia control her jealousy?

videos.overview: Filippa is looking forward to a friendship day with Ines and Mimi, but the day takes an unexpected turn and she ends up disappointed with her friends. But why does Filippa end up sharing a picture with Bjørk that Mimi had sent?

videos.title: A bloody rumor - part 2
videos.overview: Mimi discovers that Filippa is the one who shared the photo from the restroom, which has now gone viral at school - in a bad way. Filippa can only watch as the rest of the school makes fun of Mimi. Can Mimi ever forgive Filippa, or is their friendship over?

videos.title: In love with Liva?
videos.overview: When Jakob and Liva start hanging out a lot, Vester worries that Jakob would rather spend time with her. So he comes up with a brilliant prank to ruin the budding friendship between Jakob and Liva!

videos.title: Frede, the hairy beast
videos.overview: Bob and Morgan brag about their six-pack and chest hair - but what should Frede do when he has neither? He's ashamed of being hairless... until he finds a brilliant solution to the problem!

videos.title: The curse of the mummy foot
videos.overview: Vester and Jakob go on a mission to find a missing mummy foot. But the adventure takes a wild turn - and suddenly Liva appears. What does she have to do with the mission? And is there a curse on the mummy foot?

videos.title: Kiss me!
videos.overview: Sofia feels that she and August are drifting apart - and even though they've been dating for a while, they've never kissed either. How can she make a kiss feel natural? Coco offers to help, but can she even do that?

videos.title: Bjørn's worrying message
videos.overview: The class is having a history day and Liva and Pixie end up in a group with Bjørn, but as always, he doesn't show up. However, he has been spotted at school. When the girls decide to investigate, they discover that Bjørn's absence goes deeper than just truancy.

videos.title: The Aura King
videos.overview: Ruben falls to the bottom of the aura scale when Frede sees him lose to Filippa in a race. Ruben tries to regain his status by ignoring Filippa. But instead of impressing her, she is disappointed in him. Is it even cool to be the king?

videos.title: The great love drama
videos.overview: The class is having drama lessons, but when Sofia is sick, August ends up having to perform a grand love scene with Coco. Will it bring old feelings back to life when they get close again?

videos.title: The List
videos.overview: Filippa has been hacked! Someone made a best dressed list at school with Filippa's Insta and she's been placed super low on the list. Who is behind it?

videos.title: Filippa's birthday
videos.overview: Mimi and Ines have prepared a sweet homemade gift for Filippa for her birthday. But they panic when they see Filippa's birthday haul - she's only gotten super expensive gifts. How can they ever live up to her standards?

videos.title: Oskar's cruel prank
videos.overview: Oskar is convinced that nothing can scare him because he has seen so many horror movies. This provokes August, who wants to prove him wrong. He organizes a black out prank in woodwork with Sara and Leonora, but suddenly Oskar disappears without a trace.

videos.title: Fake profile
videos.overview: Vester has fallen madly in love with Victoria, whom he met online. But Liva and Jakob are afraid he's being scammed, as Vester has never met his fling in real life. How can they convince him that Victoria might not be the one after all?

videos.title: Michael gets a crush
videos.overview: The class is about to have a home-school interview and Filippa fears that she's going to be reprimanded for a terrible assignment she's done. Her fears only grow when she's horrified to find out that it's the school principal, Michael, who is conducting the interviews!

videos.title: Daniel is stealing
videos.overview: Ruben has a deal with some of the older guys at school who provide him with delicious snacks. Daniel tries to make his own deal with the tough guys, but gets caught owing them favors. Will he end up having to steal?

videos.title: The fight
videos.overview: Someone has told the whole school that Daniel has been stealing. Only Ruben knows that Daniel was caught stealing. But did Daniel's best friend really stab him in the back and rat him out? It can't be true... or can it?

videos.title: Everything has consequences
videos.overview: After the fight, Daniel and Ruben's friendship is ruined and Frede has to choose between his two best friends. But at the same time, he's frustrated that he's always in the shadow of Ruben and Daniel - and now he's also the one who has to solve their problems.

videos.title: Love's gnome gone astray
videos.overview: Leonora is the class love elf, because she always makes sure to help her elf friend find her crush. Leo gets Emmy as his elf friend and has to find out who Emmy has a crush on... but things go horribly wrong! Will Christmas be the season of hearts after all?

videos.title: Do you believe in elves?
videos.overview: Leonora believes in elves and experiences small signs of true Christmas magic. The other girls in her class laugh at her, but she refuses to give up on the idea that elves are real.

videos.title: Broken Christmas hearts
videos.overview: Coco gets the most romantic gifts from her elf, and Sofia is convinced it must be because the elf is in love with Coco. Will Sofia's heart be broken when she discovers that Coco's elf is... August?

videos.title: Sofia's paranoia
videos.overview: Christmas break is over and Sofia and August return to class as ex-boyfriends. But Sofia is nervous that Coco and August are up to something. Sara and Leonora help with lip-reading from a distance, but does it really help Sofia's paranoia?

videos.title: Everyone loves my dad
videos.overview: Daniel has finally made captain of the school's soccer team and the timing is perfect because his dad is finally home to watch the game. But Daniel's dad isn't quite as impressed as Daniel had hoped.

videos.title: New seats
videos.overview: The class needs new seats after the holidays, and Frede and Filippa have to sit next to each other. But Filippa is really mad at Frede! He doesn't understand and tries to win Ines and Mimi's trust, because they might be the way to become friends with Filippa?

videos.title: Is Liva flirting with... Jakob?
videos.overview: Vester sees Liva trying to flirt with Jakob. He convinces Jakob that Liva is crazy about him! But does Jakob reciprocate her feelings? And how does he make the leap from being Liva's friend to being Liva's... flirt?

videos.title: Ruben under indictment
videos.overview: Turid has discovered that someone has been graffitiing the school. She's sure that Ruben is the culprit! But Ruben insists he didn't do the graffiti... but then who did? And how can he find out who committed the vandalism - and prove it?

videos.title: August alone in the world
videos.overview: August doesn't know who to hang out with at recess. Oskar is at the doctor's office and August isn't really on speaking terms with Sofia after their breakup - and she's with Coco all the time. He ends up playing soccer and has to kick ass. But it doesn't feel right at all.

videos.title: Locked inside
videos.overview: Daniel and Ruben are still enemies after the fight. And it feels like the cruelest punishment in the world when Christoffer puts them together as puppets. It's impossible for the guys to work together.

videos.title: The diary thief
videos.overview: Ines forgets her diary when she talks to Frede and he is tempted to know her innermost thoughts. He manages to stop himself from reading it - but then it suddenly disappears and a mysterious insta-profile appears,

videos.title: Chatbot Crush
videos.overview: Pixie has fallen in love with a Troy Bolton chatbot, but tries to keep it hidden. Liva discovers this and shares her concerns with Vester. They try to help Pixie, but it's difficult without seeming judgmental.

videos.title: Sole Mates
videos.overview: Daniel has spent six months saving up for the coolest sneaks, and FINALLY he can flex them in class. But it turns out he's not the only one with new shoes... Morgan and Bob bought the exact same shoes and want to start a shoe club.

videos.title: Pink Pony Club
videos.overview: There's an art theme in the club and Vester has requested a dance for him and Jakob. Jakob isn't too excited about it, especially when he realizes that they have to dance in front of the WHOLE club... and in costumes to boot!

videos.title: Ines hates Valentine's Day
videos.overview: All the girls are excited about Valentine's Day, except Ines. She thinks it's a ridiculous concept and wants to cancel the day - and she gets Mimi on board. But in reality, Mimi strongly disagrees with Ines. How does she get her say?

videos.title: Coco's new friends
videos.overview: Sofia fangirles over the older girls, Cleo and Esther, which Coco finds super cringeworthy. But what happens to Sofia and Coco's friendship when Coco suddenly ditches Sofia and starts hanging out with Cleo and Esther?

videos.title: The Wild West
videos.overview: Vester and Jakob go to war with Asger and Bjørn as they compete to play the lead roles in Liva's new movie. Which pair will win this crazy battle?

videos.title: Tiny Bob
videos.overview: Bob is tired of always ending up in the goal when the boys play soccer. He feels he's always overlooked because he's small. KlubRas tries to help and organizes a limbo competition where being small is a huge advantage!

videos.title: Do I have ADHD?
videos.overview: Liva dreams of being able to say bye-bye to fractions and avoid math altogether, so when she discovers that Asger gets a pass because he has ADHD, she starts to investigate whether the symptoms don't also apply to her.

videos.title: Emmy's desert island
videos.overview: Rebekka and Sonja have organized a nail night without inviting Emmy. She feels left out, even though she doesn't care about doing nails at all. She tries to convince the girls that she's also interested in nails, but it goes horribly wrong.

videos.title: Obsessed with being perfect
videos.overview: Sofia doesn't feel good, good-looking or pretty enough and tries to avoid changing with Coco and the other girls at PE. But suddenly there's a magical cleaning lady in the changing room who tries to convince Sofia that she's perfect just the way she is.

videos.title: Ines goes viral
videos.overview: Mimi and Ines make a silly dance video and Ines explicitly asks Mimi not to share the video with others. Can Mimi keep her promise or will Ines suddenly go viral?

videos.title: On a date with Aske
videos.overview: Liva sends an invite to a movie night, but accidentally sends the text to Aske instead of Jakob and Vester. So now Aske thinks they're going on a date! How does Liva get out of the date - and can her friends Jakob and Vester help her with their always "brilliant" ideas?

videos.title: The battle for Ruben
videos.overview: Daniel and Ruben are finally best friends again. But Daniel is so afraid of losing his friend that he doesn't want to share Ruben with anyone, even at the club. Will it end in conflict again?

videos.title: Big truancy day
videos.overview: Jakob and Vester are having the hottest truancy day and decide to pull a prank. But the prank leads them back to school... where a cruel surprise awaits them!

videos.title: Committing burglary
videos.overview: KlubRas informs Sonja, Emmy and Rebekka to hand in their phones so they can be locked up while the girls are at the club. Under great protest, they hand over their phones.

videos.title: Is Oskar BETA?
videos.overview: Bob and Morgan tell Oskar that even though Leonora and Sara laugh at him when he's being silly and funny, it means that the girls don't really respect him. Oskar searches for answers and watches a bunch of videos that Bob sends.

videos.title: Get paid to read
videos.overview: Vester's parents want him to read more books in his spare time, so they pay him half a penny per page read! What his parents don't know is that he only reads easy-to-read children's books with large print and very few words on each page.

videos.title: In love with the wrong person
videos.overview: Sofia can't get over August and when she decides to win him back, Coco supports the project. They arrange an eye contact exercise, but when Coco ends up sitting across from August, she suddenly feels a budding emotion.

videos.title: Frede's grandfather
videos.overview: Frede is looking forward to seeing his grandfather, but Ines and Mimi tell him about their dead grandparents - and Frede feels a sudden fear that his grandfather may not have many days left either. What if something happens to grandpa?

videos.title: Vester's dirty power struggle
videos.overview: Pixie wants to continue on the school's activities committee, but Vester rebels and arranges for Jakob to run against her. Vester acts as a spin doctor and he will stop at nothing. He ends up rolling over Pixie, who is deeply hurt...

videos.title: Rubens star
videos.overview: Bob and Morgan jokingly use 'Jew' as an insult, which makes Filippa angry. Even more so when she finds out that Ruben is actually Jewish. Ruben wants to keep a low profile, but realizes that she's right and he needs to speak up.

videos.title: Bet it all
videos.overview: Oskar has heard that Coco is crazy about August and tries to convince August to declare his love for her. Even though August IS crazy about Coco, he doesn't dare do anything about it because she has already rejected him once.

videos.title: Cuddly darlings
videos.overview: Turid loves Ines and Ines loves to be praised by Turid. But when Asger and Bjørn call her a pet, Ines decides to get rid of her role as the teacher's favorite student. Will Ines succeed in rebelling?

videos.title: The school's secret treasure
videos.overview: Liva wants to avoid appearing childish to the other students at school... but Vester certainly doesn't help when he shows up as Dennis in his cowboy hat. Jakob and Vester manage to lure Liva on a mission anyway - does she realize that this might be a bad idea?

videos.title: Useless
videos.overview: Sonja fears she'll have to repeat a grade because she feels like she's always doing badly in school. When she finally feels like she's put a lot of effort into an assignment, she gets it back from Tara full of comments.

videos.title: BFF Break-up
videos.overview: Sofia tries to be inclusive and accept that Coco and August are dating. But it's not that easy. At the same time, she constantly feels rejected by Coco, who would rather spend time with August than Sofia. Does she have to break up with her best friend?

videos.title: Oskar's good glow
videos.overview: Overnight, Oskar has become very tan. He's been using self-tanner, but when August compliments his tan, he's embarrassed to care about his appearance - and doesn't want to admit that his great tan is due to self-tanner.

videos.title: What's going to happen to us?
videos.overview: The class is visited by coach Philip, who talks about the importance of making good future plans for yourself. Jakob, however, has no idea what he wants to do with his future. How does he choose which path to take when anything is possible?

videos.title: Scandalous interview - Part 1
videos.overview: The class is interviewing each other and Filippa and Ruben will be working together. Filippa is nervous because she really wants to get to know Ruben much better, and the interview might help her do just that... but he ends up disappointing her anyway.

videos.title: Scandalous interview - Part 2
videos.overview: Ruben gets awkward every time he tries to impress Filippa. And now he's not only made her really upset, but she's also really angry with him. It wasn't meant to be! How could it go so wrong? And can he ever make it right?

videos.title: Who is Coco?
videos.overview: When the class is asked to write about who each of them is, Coco is struck with doubt. Who is she really? She's no longer friends with Sofia, but is she just August's girlfriend?

videos.title: Fun, funnier, funniest
videos.overview: Liva has to decide which of Jakob and Vester is funnier. Having to choose between her two friends isn't easy - so... can she cheat them and avoid having to choose?

videos.title: Plaster at first sight
videos.overview: Frede helps Emmy after a bike crash and is hailed as a hero. She has a cast on her arm and everyone wants to write on it, but Frede doesn't dare. He's ashamed of his handwriting and secretly tries to improve it. Why does he want to make an impression so badly?

videos.title: The princes of prepping
videos.overview: Vester and Jakob have converted a secret closet at school into a food warehouse. All they hear about on the news is the importance of prepping. But someone is stealing from their pantry... Is the thief an enemy or an ally?

videos.title: Ines-cape room
videos.overview: The new middle school students are going to be shown around, and the class is tasked with organizing something fun for them. Ines has a plan ready for an escape room, but Mimi and the other girls aren’t quite as keen on the idea.

videos.title: Cold air
videos.overview: Ruben and Filippa aren't speaking to each other after the interview incident. Filippa is still furious with Ruben, and Daniel can't stand to see his friend suffering. He realizes he has to step in and help smooth things over, so he decides to play matchmaker.

videos.title: We're heading to Hansa Park
videos.overview: Vester and Jakob have been on the school patrol all year and are now close to reaping the rewards and going on the annual trip to Hansa Park. On his last day on duty, however, Vester comes down with a fever and feels sick, but he refuses to call in sick.

videos.title: Fries and guys
videos.overview: Filippa has kissed Ruben, and she’s really excited to share the news with her friends—until she finds out that Ines has completely different plans for their summer: she wants to ban all talk of boys!

videos.title: Goodbye again?
videos.overview: Coco’s mom is offered a job in Paris, and Coco is getting ready to leave again. Will she have to break up with August? Or can they stay together even if Coco lives in Paris?

videos.title: One last chance
videos.overview: August is feeling absolutely down in the dumps after Coco broke up with him. But when he finds out that she isn't going to Paris after all, he regains his hope. He has to give it another shot—maybe love will get one last chance?
